cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.description:
When I comment out lines 246, 247 and 251 of sched.rs (i.e. never enable the mpu), and flash the rng test app, I get normal output from the app, which is expected.

https://github.com/tock/tock/blob/d67c9d5e70ace179134bbf918525f85384985d33/kernel/src/sched.rs#L241-L251

However, when I now additionally comment out the body of setup_mpu in process.rs, a function which is not called anywhere else, the rng app faults with [this](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1v1Cq1_CzI_5DjZfXRBpUqSmxIx4ZdfJf/view?usp=sharing) error message.

The expected behaviour was normal output from the app. This test was performed on a Hail.

I did a git bisect, and found that "kernel: move chip specific print to arch crate" (part of PR #1115) is the first commit that introduces this issue. Also, @hudson-ayers has mentioned that he gets the same panic message when running certain test apps after he merged commits from master including or past "Merge #1113" into his IP Userland branch.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix undefined behavior in context switch that caused faults
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix undefined behavior in context switch that caused faults

### Pull Request Overview

Closes #1160

Under some circumstances, the process GOT or stored registers seem to get corrupted (details for how to reproduce in #1160). It's been a very difficult bug to isolate since it doesn't appear (or doesn't appear in the same way) when debugging. It also is highly tied to the particular kernel configuration, which implies it probably has something to do with how kernel flash/memory is laid out, i.e. it might be an alignment issue with some structure.

The two fixes included in this PR seem to fix the problem, at least for now:

- MapCell

- `switch_to_user`, had a type that didn't quite match the the values being passed in and returned (e.g. `*const u8` vs. `*const usize`), which could impact alignment.

- The cortex-m crate stored the registers in meaningfully named struct fields and then unsafely casted them to a byte array. That's not necessarily a problem, but technically these things could be aligned differently as the alignment was not strictly defined.

Note that despite my theory that this somehow has to do with undefined behavior in MapCell, i tried merging with #1155 and it didn't fix the problem, implying that either that's not the issue, or that there is still some undefined behavior in MapCell (which wouldn't be that surprising).

### Testing Strategy

I tested this by running both manifesting bugs listed in #1160 with and without these changes (as well as many others I tried) and verifying they worked with these changes.

### TODO or Help Wanted

Which set of applications <-> platforms should we run as additional tests to convince ourselves this change doesn't just move the bug somewhere else?
